title: Savings & Copay Assistance Programs Desk Guidance: Coverage Points on the Kestrel Rx Savings Club Renewal Fee
content:
The Kestrel Rx Savings Club renewal fee's coverage points under the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs depend on the patient's prescription insurance records under Prescription Insurance on File:

- a patient with **no coverage record in active status** whose **latest terminated coverage record closed fewer than 12 whole months before today** earns **10 points off**;
- a patient with **no coverage record in active status** and **no terminated coverage record closed in those 12 months** earns **5 points off**;
- a patient with **a coverage record in active status** earns none.

A point off is one percentage point off the enrollment fee in the renewal fee for the membership term. The renewal fee's points off are first added into one total percentage, and the enrollment fee is reduced once by that total percentage and rounded to the cent half up; the points never act one after another.

## Truth table

| Any coverage record in active status? | Latest terminated record closed fewer than 12 whole months before today? | Coverage points off |
|---|---|---|
| No | Yes | 10 |
| No | No (closed 12 whole months ago or earlier, or no terminated record at all) | 5 |
| Yes | either | 0 |

## Boundary of the 12-month look-back (hypothetical patients with no active coverage)

- Latest terminated coverage record closed 11 whole months before today: 10 points off.
- Latest terminated coverage record closed exactly 12 whole months before today: not fewer than 12, so 5 points off.
- No terminated coverage record at all: 5 points off.
